lines.t: I feast upon what feeds my soul, not bread that fades away
I remember you, your passion, Lord, the price you chose to pay
I lift my thanks before Your throne
My heart laid bare before Your eyes
Not by the work of my hands
But by the truth of who I am before you
I bring no boast, no offering
For you desire a broken heart
Your love and mercy calls me now
Lord, you died for me. Unleaven my heart, Lord. Make my spirit new. Unleaven my heart, Lord. Let me walk in you.
For the heart speaks louder still than any gift I place before you. Unleaven my heart, Lord. Let no pride remain.
Let truth and light in me stay
A heart made clean, a heart made right, alive in You, restored in life
Unleaven my heart, Lord, I cry out Your name
Unleaven my heart, Lord, forever You reign
Unleaven my heart, Lord, let no pride remain
Unleaven my heart, Lord. Wash away the stain. I remember your love. I remember the cost. Unleaven my heart, Lord. I am yours. I am yours.
I feast on you, my living bread
By mercy's hand I'm gently led
